big_case.notes: This case presents recurrent Fifth Amendment takings finality and prudential-ripeness questions (specifically whether a landowner must exhaust legislative map-amendment remedies) backed by Pacific Legal Foundation and six cert-stage amicus briefs. However, it arises from an unpublished per curiam decision involving a single residential parcel's well-and-septic permit dispute and was denied certiorari without dissent, giving it moderate doctrinal interest for land-use litigants but low broader public or institutional salience.
